title: Propagation of Chaos and Gaussian Fluctuations for Mean-field Coupled Maps
summary: We study a class of discrete-time interacting particle systems arising from mean-field coupled maps. We establish a Dobrushin-type estimate, a relative entropy estimate and Central Limit Theorem (CLT) type results for this class of systems. First we control the growth of the 1-Wasserstein distance between the empirical measures and the limiting distributions. Then we use the relative entropy method to show the propagation of chaos.
